title: Set up your nickname and profile
description: Before you start using PoRoom, set your nickname, character, and job. Other members in a room will see this info.
positionHint: Your job changes the status list in a [Room] and the work unit (characters/panels). You can change this anytime from the [Me] page.
birthHint: You must be 14 or older to join. We do not store your full date of birth, only the year.
consentDescription: To keep using PoRoom, please confirm your date of birth and agree to the terms. Users under 14 cannot use the Service.
